question.prompt: Calculate \((-3)\times(-4)\) and \((-5)\times2\). (Give your answers in order, separated by a comma.)

solutions.explanation: The product of 2 numbers with the same sign is positive; multiply their absolute values: \((-3)\times(-4)=12\). The product of numbers with opposite signs is negative: \((-5)\times2=-10\).
solutions.title: Determine signs and multiply magnitudes
